output_list.reason: The mint function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalSupply + value <= TOKEN_LIMIT check is bypassed if value is crafted to overflow.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balances[msg.sender] += value; check is bypassed if value is crafted to overflow.
The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balances[_to] = balances[_to].add(_value); check is bypassed if _value is crafted to overflow.
The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value; check is bypassed if _value is crafted to overflow.

The increaseApproval function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = allowed[msg.sender][_spender].add(_addedValue); check is bypassed if _addedValue is crafted to overflow.
The decreaseApproval function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = oldValue.sub(_subtractedValue); check is bypassed if _subtractedValue is crafted to overflow.
